title: Initial speed at A
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the speed (5 m/s) of the combined sliders as they enter the track at point A, using projectile motion from the platform.

title: Normal force at O
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the normal force (129 N) at the lowest point O using energy conservation and Newton's second law.

title: Energy loss in collision
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the mechanical energy lost (13.5 J) during the inelastic collision between sliders P and Q.

title: Impulse on slider P
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the magnitude of the horizontal impulse (12 N·s) applied to slider P initially.

title: Conservation of momentum
description: Important: Applies momentum conservation to the inelastic collision to relate the speed of P before collision to the horizontal speed after.

title: Work-energy on platform
description: Important: Applies the work-energy theorem to slider P's motion across the rough platform to find its speed before collision.

title: Projectile kinematics
description: Important: Correctly resolves the velocity at A into horizontal and vertical components using the given fall height and angle.

title: Energy conservation on track
description: Important: Applies mechanical energy conservation between point A and the lowest point O of the circular track.

title: Sign or unit error
description: Pitfall: Makes a sign error in the work-energy equation (friction) or misapplies the angle (53° vs 106°).

title: Force balance misconception
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly applies Newton's second law at point O (e.g., using centripetal force as the normal force).
